item.title: How a Rajasthan Village Became 100% Zero Waste?
item.description: #thebetterindia Aandhi Gaon in Rajasthan has done the impossible — become a 100% zero-waste, self-sustaining village. Thanks to Dr Sudipti Arora, who worked through Stage 2 cancer to build vermi-filters, biogas systems, and floating wetlands that recycle every drop of water and every bit of waste.
